```python import pytest from youtube_dl.extractor.itv import ITVBTCCIE from youtube_dl.utils import ExtractorError # Helper to create a fake webpage with given video IDs def fake_webpage(video_ids): return ''.join( f'
' for vid in video_ids ) def test_itvbtccie_normal_extraction(monkeypatch): """Test that a normal URL returns the expected playlist entries.""" # Arrange url = 'http://www.itv.com/btcc/races/btcc-2018-all-the-action-from-brands-hatch' ie = ITVBTCCIE() # Mock the webpage download to return a page with three video IDs monkeypatch.setattr( ie, '_download_webpage', lambda u, i: fake_webpage(['123', '456', '789']) ) # Act result = ie._real_extract(url) # Assert assert result['entries'] == [ ie.url_result( 'http://players.brightcove.net/1582188683001/HkiHLnNRx_default/index.html?videoId=123', ie=ie.ie_key(), video_id='123' ), ie.url_result( 'http://players.brightcove.net/1582188683001/HkiHLnNRx_default/index.html?videoId=456', ie=ie.ie_key(), video_id='456' ), ie.url_result( 'http://players.brightcove.net/1582188683001/HkiHLnNRx_default/index.html?videoId=789', ie=ie.ie_key(), video_id='789' ), ] assert result['id'] == 'btcc-2018-all-the-action-from-brands-hatch' assert result['title'] == 'BTCC 2018: All the action from Brands Hatch' def test_itvbtccie_no_video_ids(monkeypatch): """Test that a page with no video IDs yields an empty playlist.""" url = 'http://www.itv.com/btcc/races/empty' ie = ITVBTCCIE() monkeypatch.setattr( ie, '_download_webpage', lambda u, i: 'No videos here' ) result = ie._real_extract(url) assert result['entries'] == [] assert result['id'] == 'empty' # Title may be None if not found assert result['title'] is None def test_itvbtccie_invalid_url_raises(): """Test that an invalid URL raises ExtractorError.""" ie = ITVBTCCIE() with pytest.raises(ExtractorError): ie._real_extract('http://example.com/not-itv') ```
